justifications.durability: each inverted test reddens under its recorded mutation (logs/red-arm-clear.log fails test_mark_signals_underspecified_clears_a_stored_role on the surviving role), but the assertion at tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py:480 compares a value that moves with the value under test.
justifications.evidence: the gained commits' gate is recorded and re-read — the three red arms (logs/red-arm-predicate.log, red-arm-judge.log, red-arm-clear.log, each 1 failed EXIT=1) and the base/head suite pair (logs/gate-discovery-base.log 1573 passed, logs/gate-discovery-head.log 1576 passed, both EXIT=0) — while the original done_when's agreement measure is superseded by the blind verdict rather than met.
justifications.fit: the reverted comment at parallel.py:1909 states the mechanism (the judge disagreed with a blind hand-read on 4 of 30) with no plan or ticket identifier, and the fragment's prose follows its sibling records' style.
justifications.goal_fidelity: the landed change at parallel.py:1918 and parallel.py:2223 does the opposite of the goal sentence — an underspecified signal carries no role and is excluded from the predicate — a reversal the plan's §13 authorising gate (its failed blind re-measurement, 26 of 30) licenses but which does not deliver the stated deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the change returns to the shared predicate owner _SIGNAL_ROLE_MISSING_WHERE (parallel.py:1917) and removes the forked judgement path; the added _RoleGraph status branch (tests/discovery/test_signal_role_store.py:108) models FacilitySignal state rather than capturing statements, so it extends no owner that exists and tests/recording_graph_client.py is absent.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the diff from 46531f088 to b7038eacd is one of the three declared write paths in the manifest, and no other file is touched.
